text: A read of the dashboard's snapshot downloads it only when it changed, and a hidden tab reads nothing (#854). Every open tab read the whole snapshot, 212 KB gzipped, every 15 seconds with no validator, though it changes once per refresh, and went on doing it hidden: about 51 MB an hour per tab, measured on 2026-11-11. The server now tags the snapshot it publishes with a hash of its bytes and answers a read that names that tag with 304 and no body, in the tag's weak form too, since a proxy that compresses again sends it back so. The page names the tag it last read and leaves everything as it is on a 304. A hidden page stops its snapshot and live reads, and reads at once when it's shown. The snapshot's own bytes still change at every refresh, with its generation time and each open wait's end, so a tab in view gets one body per refresh; keeping the body the same when nothing real changed is a later step.
